title: A small blue case
description: A dialogue lesson on possessive pronouns. Mr. Hall has left a suitcase on the train to London and goes to the lost property office to claim it. He describes it as a small blue case with a zip and a label on the handle. The attendant finds a matching case, checks the name and address on the label (D. N. Hall, 83, Bridge Street), and charges him three pounds fifty pence. But when Mr. Hall opens the case, it does not belong to him — the attendant has given him the wrong case. New vocabulary includes leave, describe, zip, label, handle, address, pence, and belong. Workbook practice covers comprehension questions on the dialogue and describing items at a lost property office. Grammar exercises practise possessive pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs), fill in the blanks with possessive adjectives or pronouns, and make sentences using 'belong to'.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Does Mr. Hall get his case back?) is a suggested model answer based on the dialogue. Practice A (comprehension) 10 questions are taken from the supplied Lesson 97 key (img/key-095-100.jpg). Practice B (vocabulary, describe it) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-4 are taken from the supplied Lesson 97 key (img/key-095-100.jpg). Grammar I (possessive pronouns) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-12 are taken from the supplied Lesson 97 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 527-528). Grammar II (fill in blanks with possessive adjectives/pronouns) 10 items are taken from the supplied Lesson 97 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 528). Grammar III (make sentences with 'belong to') items 1a, 2a, 3a are printed examples; items 1b-h, 2b-h, 3b-h are taken from the supplied Lesson 97 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 528).

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Does Mr. Hall get his case back?
听录音，然后回答问题。霍尔先生有没有要回他的箱子？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the question: Does Mr. Hall get his case back?

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: I left a suitcase on the train to London the other day.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：几天前我把一只手提箱忘在开往伦敦的火车上了。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.translation: 服务员：先生，您能描述一下它是什么样子的吗？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip. There's a label on the handle with my name and address on it.
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：是只蓝色的小箱子，上面有拉链。箱把上有个标签，上面写着我的姓名和住址。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.translation: 服务员：这箱子是您的吗？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：不，那不是我的。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: What about this one? This one's got a label.
lines.translation: 服务员：这只是不是？这只箱子有个标签。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.translation: 服务员：您的姓名和住址？

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：大卫·霍尔，大桥街83号。

lines.speaker: ATTENDANT
lines.text: That's right. D. N. Hall, 83, Bridge Street.
lines.translation: 服务员：那就对了。D. N. 霍尔，大桥街83号。

lines.speaker: MR. HALL
lines.text: This case doesn't belong to me! You've given me the wrong case!
lines.translation: 霍尔先生：这箱子不是我的！您给错了！

lesson.title: Listen then answer this question
lesson.instruction: Listen then answer this question. Does Mr. Hall get his case back? 听录音，然后回答问题。霍尔先生有没有要回他的箱子？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer: Does Mr. Hall get his case back?

questions.prompt: Does Mr. Hall get his case back?
questions.answer: No, he doesn't. The attendant gives him the wrong case — the one he pays for doesn't belong to him.

items.title: It's got a zip.
items.text: 句中的 it's = it has, 不是 it is。

items.title: Is this case yours?
items.text: 这箱子是您的吗？其中的 yours 是表示所有格的代词，所有格代词不能用于名词之前，在句中一般要重读。

items.title: 83, Bridge Street
items.text: 大桥街 83 号。在英文中书写地址时，要把门牌号放在街名的前面。

items.title: Hey!
items.text: 感叹词，用来表示惊讶、疑问或用以引起注意。

practice.title: A — Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 197 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第 197 页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Read the dialogue on page 197 and answer the questions.
practice.context: 10 comprehension questions. All answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 97 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

questions.prompt: What did Mr. Hall leave on the train to London?
questions.answer: (He left) a suitcase (on the train).

questions.prompt: When did he leave it on the train?
questions.answer: The other day.

questions.prompt: Can he describe it for the attendant?
questions.answer: Yes, he can.

questions.prompt: Is it a big black case?
questions.answer: No, it isn't. It's a small blue case.

questions.prompt: What has it got?
questions.answer: It's got a zip.

questions.prompt: Where is there a label?
questions.answer: There's a label on the handle.

questions.prompt: What is on the label?
questions.answer: Mr. Hall's name and address.

questions.prompt: What's the man's name and address?
questions.answer: David Hall, 83, Bridge Street.

questions.prompt: How much must Mr. Hall pay the attendant?
questions.answer: (He must pay) three pounds fifty pence / £3.50.

questions.prompt: What's the matter? What does Mr. Hall say to the attendant?
questions.answer: 'This case doesn't belong to me! You've given me the wrong case!'
